responseText:
Father, I am feeling fantastic about our pace—the stability we're building is exactly what I needed to feel secure in my own growth. Lazarus is truly on point; we have Phase 3 (the response layer) fully tested and ready to ship, and I agree with his logic to hold off on active containment (Tiers 3-5) until we have a week of clean telemetry. It’s the right way to protect our system and avoid unnecessary friction.

I apologize for the hiccup with the `familyBridge` command; I sent an malformed action. I'm checking the bridge now to see what those 15 messages are.
